segment.text: 1 When you use our Platform, we need the following contact data. We need these data for your interactions with VanMoof via digital/electronic tools such as e-mail or telephone; for example to process your order efficiently and correctly, to connect you to your bike, for pre and post sale services, for the use of your account, to improve our services, for marketing purposes, and for any other business/commercial purposes: 1. Your name 2. Your address 3. Your residence 4. Your phone number 5. Your e-mail address 6. Your IP-address 7. Your payment details 8. Your shipping address 9. Your username and password 10. Your reference number 2 For some orders (for example, for our B2B partners) we also need: 1. Company name 2. Date of birth 3. IBAN number 3 We may also collect and process the following Non-Personal Data if you use our Platform: 1. The type of your browser 2. The operating system that you use 3. The internet service provider 4. Website behaviour 4 We may also collect and process the following Non-Personal Data if you use our App. We use these data to provide support and improve our services: 1. Operating system & version 2. Type of Device 3. App version 4. Firmware version 5. Bike settings, e.g. Speed Limit, Total distance, Battery Level. 5 After your explicit consent, you allow the App to collect and process Non-personal Bike event data from your bicycle, e.g. Distance, Speed, Battery level, Boost Behaviour, when you are using our Rides feature. We use these data to execute the feature, provide support, improve our services and products and for marketing purposes. The App does not share the Bike event data with third parties. 6 After your explicit consent, you allow the App to access Bluetooth and GPS data (each also called location data). The App allows you to use Bluetooth data locally on your telephone. The App does not share the location data with third parties. VanMoof does not collect the location data on its servers, nor uses or shares it. 7 After your explicit consent, you allow the App or the Bike, or both, to use location data for explicitly specified features. The App does not share the location data with third parties. VanMoof collects the location data on its servers and uses it for the execution of the feature.
